# Opening parser fixtures

`parser-two-page.pdf` is a committed, synthetic two-page PDF generated by the pure-Python minimal PDF writer used by the parser tests. It contains no real user data and requires no additional pip dependencies.

Generation command: run the `write_pdf` helper in `services/parser/tests/test_conversion.py` with the output path `tests/fixtures/opening/parser-two-page.pdf`.
